title: The patient's consent wallet
html:
PROTOTYPE JOURNEY 00

The patient's consent wallet.

One calm place where a patient sees every permission they've given, who has actually opened their records, and what's waiting for a yes or no.

  • See every grant — which hospital, for what purpose, and until when.
  • Know who looked — a plain log of every access, with a timestamp.
  • Decide in one tap — approve or decline new requests, or withdraw anytime.

This is the patient side of the DPDP "right to know" — the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 gives people the right to see who holds their data and what's been done with it. The Hub turns that right into a screen they can actually use.

title: Emergency access, without blocking care
html:
PROTOTYPE JOURNEY 00

Emergency access, without blocking care.

An unconscious patient. No consent on file. Execution must never stand between a doctor and a life — so the Hub grants access in seconds, then logs every override for review. Care first; accountability always.

hub.certinal.health / er / patient-lookup
ER Clinician · On shiftDr. Arjun Rao Request
Pull records to treat the patient
A patient arrives unconscious in the Emergency Room. The clinician opens their record to make a safe call — fast.
Unidentified patient · ER-2291Brought in unconscious · no next-of-kin present Critical
No standing consent on file. Normally execution would block this access — but the patient can’t consent, and waiting could cost a life.
ER Clinician · Break-glassDr. Arjun Rao Override
Invoke emergency override
“Break-glass” lets a clinician proceed without prior consent in a genuine emergency. It is a deliberate, recorded act — not a back door.

title: Prototype · Cross-provider

PROTOTYPE JOURNEY 00

Moving records between hospitals.

The patient changes hospitals. Their history should follow them — but only the records they agree to, for the reason they agree to, and only for as long as they say. The Hub rides ABDM's exchange rails and turns that permission into something it can prove.
